title: New ERA Energy & Digital, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. (NUAI) filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 disclosing equity issuances to SharonAI, Inc. (893,724 shares) and Zachary Yi Zhou (1,522,389 shares) related to a prior acquisition agreement, and announced postponement of a Special Meeting from April 15 to April 16, 2026, along with notice of convertible note prepayment to occur April 24, 2026. This is a micro-cap corporate filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Company issued 893,724 shares of common stock to SharonAI, Inc. pursuant to a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated January 16, 2026
Company issued 1,522,389 shares of common stock to Zachary Yi Zhou pursuant to an Amended and Restated Promissory Note dated April 6, 2026
Special Meeting of Stockholders postponed from April 15, 2026 to April 16, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time
Record date for the Special Meeting remains March 3, 2026
Company delivered notice on April 10, 2026 to prepay the Convertible Note on April 24, 2026
SharonAI has until April 17, 2026 to elect conversion of up to 20% of the Convertible Note into common stock
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate SEC filing for a micro-cap company (NUAI) that is not relevant to macro catalysts or market structure. The filing concerns internal corporate actions including equity issuances, a shareholder meeting postponement, and debt prepayment related to an acquisition of SharonAI's interest in Texas Critical Data Centers LLC.
